cards.lore: Peace is a failure of imagination. If it's quiet, you're doing it wrong.
cards.power: Play when a scene is calm. Force an immediate aggression check.

cards.lore: When in doubt, have a man come through the door with a gun.
cards.power: Interrupt any action. A new threat enters the scene immediately.

cards.lore: Hold this. Now you hate your best friend. Don't ask why.
cards.power: Target player becomes irrationally angry at an ally. Logic is negated.

cards.lore: Stray bullets have a homing beacon for importance.
cards.power: Reroll a missed attack. It now hits the most tragic target possible.

cards.lore: It's your turn to be the moron so the plot can happen.
cards.power: Target player makes the worst tactical choice available.

cards.lore: Screaming the ex's name is the nuclear option of romance.
cards.power: Maximum social damage. Turn an ally into a nemesis instantly.

cards.lore: Security fails exactly when the narrative needs it to.
cards.power: Bypass all security measures for the sake of plot speed.

cards.lore: They hate each other so much they might just get married.
cards.power: Enemies refuse to fight. They argue breathlessly instead.

cards.lore: Created to die so the hero can feel sad for five minutes.
cards.power: Sacrifice this card to negate all damage to the main character.

cards.lore: Fighting over the tiny creature is more dramatic than raising it.
cards.power: Distract two players with a legal subplot. They are removed from combat.

cards.lore: Calculated strictly for maximum shock value. Logic optional.
cards.power: Reveal a shocking backstory. Stun all players for one round.

cards.lore: The sky agrees with the plot twist.
cards.power: Play immediately after a revelation. Drown out any counter-argument.

cards.lore: No exit means forced character development.
cards.power: Force two characters to share the same space. Neither can leave until one drops.

cards.lore: Infrastructure always waits for the hero to cross before collapsing.
cards.power: The environment fails. All players must roll for agility or fall.

cards.lore: Meteorology bowing down to aesthetics.
cards.power: Look cool. Add +3 to any Rhetoric roll.

cards.lore: If it's on the wall in Act 1, it must kill someone by Act 3.
cards.power: Place face up. Cannot be used until the game is almost over. Then: Auto-kill.

cards.lore: Ammo scarcity creates tension. The last shot never misses.
cards.power: If you have no resources left, your attack roll is a Critical Hit.

cards.lore: The universal symbol for "I just heard bad news".
cards.power: Interrupt a conversation with a loud noise. End the scene.

cards.lore: Identity is fluid when the ratings drop.
cards.power: Swap your character sheet with another player.

cards.lore: If it's crazy enough to work, it will work.
cards.power: If the difficulty is Impossible (10+), you succeed automatically.

cards.lore: The universe is actively conspiring against your plans.
cards.power: Force the GM to introduce a new complication.

cards.lore: Time is not linear; it compresses near the explosion.
cards.power: All players must act in 5 seconds or take damage.

cards.lore: Sudden bad luck just because things were going too well.
cards.power: Cancel a success. Misery occurs out of nowhere.

cards.lore: Two paws, one trigger. Math says someone gets hurt.
cards.power: Both players take damage. Randomly decide who gets the weapon.

cards.lore: If it doesn't stop the plot, it doesn't stop the hero.
cards.power: Ignore one fatal blow. You are hurt, but look cool.

cards.lore: Inefficient combat designed purely for conversation.
cards.power: Pause combat to exchange witty dialogue. No damage dealt.

cards.lore: Collateral damage scaled for maximum spectacle.
cards.power: A small failure cascades into total party wipe.

cards.lore: Don't look at the plot hole. Look at the shiny distraction.
cards.power: Ignore a rule or logic hole. "It just works."

cards.lore: We have always been at war with Eastasia. Trust me.
cards.power: Change a decision made three turns ago.

cards.lore: The ending isn't an ending; it's a product placement.
cards.power: If defeated, you return in the next game with +2 stats.

cards.lore: Artificial suspense because the writers need a break.
cards.power: Pause the game immediately. Resume next week.

cards.lore: Darker and edgier means better, right?
cards.power: Gain +2 Power for every Trauma token you accept.

cards.lore: Stability is boring. Let's ruin the relationship for ratings.
cards.power: Regain health by creating unnecessary interpersonal drama.

cards.lore: Realism and the Rule of Drama having a violent affair.
cards.power: Kill a non-essential NPC to prove the stakes are real.

cards.lore: Weaponized sadness. Resistance is futile.
cards.power: Make the opponent cry. They lose a turn due to blurry vision.

cards.lore: I'm just a poor, innocent victim. Ignore the teeth.
cards.power: Convince a hero to release you from captivity.

cards.lore: You're ashamed of me, aren't you? (Gaslighting +10).
cards.power: Inflict guilt. Target loses confidence and rolls at disadvantage.

cards.lore: Evidence is inconvenient until the last 5 minutes.
cards.power: Destroy evidence. The mystery must last 2 more rounds.

cards.lore: Lighting conditions that favor the dramatic entrance.
cards.power: Enter a scene late, but take control of the narrative immediately.

cards.lore: Physics yields to the power of friendship.
cards.power: Your strength stat becomes infinite for one single action.

cards.lore: Subtlety is for people who don't want screen time.
cards.power: Shout your action. If you are loud enough, it succeeds.

cards.lore: Reverse the polarity of the neutron flow!
cards.power: Invent a solution using jargon. It works instantly.

cards.lore: Personality consistency is a shackle. Break it.
cards.power: Use a skill your character does not have, just this once.

cards.lore: Time stops when we need to talk about our feelings.
cards.power: Extend the game round even if time has run out.

cards.lore: Useful information has a delivery delay.
cards.power: Reveal a key fact after the damage is already done.

cards.lore: If we solve the problem efficiently, the episode ends early.
cards.power: Point out a simple solution. The GM must ban it immediately.

cards.lore: Give them hope so despair hurts more.
cards.power: Heal a player fully, then deal double damage next turn.

cards.lore: Total stakes. No do-overs. The franchise depends on it.
cards.power: Raise the stakes. If the heroes lose this roll, the game is over forever.

cards.lore: Safety is just a transition to a new danger.
cards.power: Escape a grapple, but take damage from the environment immediately.

cards.lore: You can't win in the first act. It's against the rules.
cards.power: The villain's plan succeeds automatically this turn.

cards.lore: It has to get louder. It has to get bigger.
cards.power: Every turn, add +1 to all damage rolls.

cards.lore: Efficiency is boring. Complexity is dramatic.
cards.power: The villain wastes a turn setting up a trap instead of attacking.

cards.lore: I just love the sound of my own madness.
cards.power: Stun yourself to explain your evil plan in detail.

cards.lore: The universe loves irony more than physics.
cards.power: Say "It can't get worse." Triple the threat level immediately.

cards.lore: Mystery is the best armor.
cards.power: You cannot be targeted until you attack.
